book.name: 1 KOLINITA
book.title: Kolinita wali Leta Houwan Pol wana Leleli

content: Mulolu ana Ahiahi Bana

Valila no leta elana nel etega ku neli ku ba, “Ga naha ola ge mani naha teliteli Yehoba wana gamagalau toekelesiya labi Yudiya kaiweliya?” Inoke sauga ya wami nel na lahe. He nuku ginol ni ola valila ya ba toekelesiya labi Galatiya hi ginol.

Sande maisena ge maisena, komiu maisena ge maisena mani enuna nuku teli getogaan. Henala ebo ni waisi elana ni teli pwabwaya, henala ebo ni pulowan elana kekeisi ya te ni teli. Mani o nuku teli bubun, inoke sauga ebo na nowa, nige ta nuwanuwatu mani ana ahiahi kaiwena.

Bolau enuna nuku hilel mani o ana tokaval, inoke sauga ebo na nowa, abwe tohouwa Yelusalema wali leta na ginol ge bolau o na pamasalil. Inoke ginebi ge leta na patunal wami mulolu nihi pwatanik Yelusalema.
Ebo ni mweyaha elau, inoke alowau naha nok.
Pol Abwe Ni Nok Kolinita ge Gamagalau Enuna Baliya
Na nok ga na na labi Masidoniya, yaka abwe na nowa eliyamiu.
Tabam alowau komiu ta minamina sauga kekeisi ga ni yapu, o ebo alowau komiu ana siga mana ana sauga ni mowasi. Inoke abwe nuku labeyau hauna labi ya nonoek.
Nige nuwau na nokenan-agimiu ya ge na tataluwagimiu. Yaa nuwau alowau komiu ta minamina ga sauga kekeisi ni yapu, ebo Yehoba wana nuwatu i ola.
He na minaa ga te Epeso ana siga Pentikos Hagalena ana sauga.
Bwagana o topihigelgel hi gewi, na minaa ga, kaiwena tuwalali ana nog iyaka i mwapwela hot eliyau.
Ebo Timoti ni nowa eliyamiu, nuku ahe nuku yaliyaya-an inoke bahi ni tohitohi-agimiu, kaiwena Babala wana tuwalali i awaawaginol i ola nau.
Bahi etega ni aawa tobwagaan. Ge wana sauga egon elana, nuku labe yaka alona wana yaliyaya ni sikalim eliyau. He nau iyahe ya matamatan alonau ge talilau kaiweliya.
He talila Apolosa bana, ya ba pagasisi eliyana tage alonau ge talilau nihi nowa ge ni kitemiu. Yaa nige i tatalam tage sauga ya ni nowa. Ebo wana sauga waiwaisana etega ni gan, inoke abwe ni nowa.
Nuku matahikagimiu, nuku milil gagasisi abulilek elana, nuku atimatuwa ge nuku gasisi.
Bugul gegewena nuku ginolil alona ge wami nunuwana.

Ku atena te Setepano alonau ge wana boda heliya houwan hot hi tabwa toabulilek wami labi Akaiya elana, ge hi talamwagil hi tuwatuwalali Yehoba wana gamagalau kaiweliya. Taliwau ge nuwau, ya ba pagasisemiu,
nuku minaa gamagalau ololal o wali logugui gabulanaa, ge i ola al gamagalau gegewel bolo wala tuwalali hi logasisi-an.
Ya yaliyaya Setepano, Potunetas ge Akaikas wali nem kaiwena. He ami bwaga i yapu elau nige bosowaina na kitemiu, yaa hi nem inoke hi payaliyaya-agau.
Valila ya nuwanuwatu kaiwemiu, yaa heliya hi payaliyaya-agau, ge komiu al ge hi payaliyaya-agimiu. Gamagalau ololal o nuku awatauwagil.
Ba Lokaiyoni
Ekelesiya bolo labi Eisiya hi mulolu eliyamiu. Akuila alona ge lagona Pilisila, avaliyau toekelesiya bolo hi nonogogowa wali limiya, Babala alana elana hi mulolu nabiyan eliyamiu.
Ge i ola al, talilau gegewel labi ya elana hi mulolu eliyamiu. Nimamiu nuku paelu alomiyau elal ge nuku pemumulolu-agimiu, kaiwena komiu Yehoba wana gamagalau.
Sauga ya totou nimwau elana na leleli.
Nau Pol ya mulolu eliyamiu.
Henala ebo nige wala Babala i nunuwana-an, Yehoba ni lahe! Babala, u nem!
Babala Yeisu wana mulolu ni minaa eliyamiu.
No nunuwana ni minaa ku gewigewi eliyamiu, kaiwena kila Keliso Yeisu wana boda.

footnotes.text: Buki ya awalehina gegewena ana baaba Pol i baunan ya, ge gamagal getoga i leleli ana siga 16:20 elana.
